watch.summary: A streamer attempts to camouflage his character inside a wall cutout prop but laughs uncontrollably as he discovers his limbs and butt are blatantly sticking out.

beats.what: The streamer inspects his character positioning against a wall cutout.
He zooms in and realizes his leg is sticking out.
He bursts into laughter seeing how visible he is.
He checks the right side and sees his arm sticking out too.
He sees his character's butt completely protruding from the wall.
He laughs and accepts that he is cooked as the hide timer ends.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The visual visual failure of his character's body sticking out everywhere paired with his genuine, infectious laughter creates instant visual humor that anyone can enjoy.
